title: pavonia sidifolia f. morongii
intro: Pavonia sidifolia f. morongii, commonly known as Mexican Rosemallow, is a species of plant in the family Malvaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and aiding in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Pavonia sidifolia f. morongii include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
